description: Work out the GDPR / UK GDPR Article 33 deadline for notifying a personal data breach: 72 elapsed hours from becoming aware, given as local time in the person's time zone (IANA zone with daylight saving, or a fixed UTC offset) and in UTC. Returns the deadline, which authority to notify (lead authority, every EU authority where affected people live, or the UK Information Commission), the steps for a controller or processor with their article references, official sources, last-checked date and page link. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested deadline module.

aware.description: When the organisation became aware of the personal data breach: local date and time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in time_zone (or utc_offset).

role.description: controller = decides why and how the data is used; processor = handles the data for a client.

scope.description: Which apply (any combination): eu_main = EU GDPR, main establishment in the EU; eu_none = EU GDPR, no establishment in the EU (serves EU users from outside); uk = UK GDPR, affected people in the UK. Empty or left out = all three. Decides which authority is notified.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the person, e.g. "Europe/London", "Asia/Karachi", "America/Los_Angeles". Daylight saving time is applied. Give this or utc_offset; with neither, times are UTC.

utc_offset.description: Fixed offset from UTC instead of time_zone, e.g. "+05:00" or "-04:00" (no daylight-saving changes). Default "+00:00" (UTC).

name: breach_notification_deadline
title: GDPR / UK GDPR 72-hour breach notification deadline
